about.headline: The Strategist Framework
about.p1: I am a Gurgaon-based content strategist and copywriter with over five years of active experience shipping copy that works. I do not describe myself as a 'storyteller' or offer 'words that sell.'
about.p2: Instead, I treat copy as an engineering problem. Most copywriting fails because it starts with drafting headlines. I start by auditing your conversion metrics, interviewing your target audience, and aligning value propositions with direct buyer motivations.
about.p3: Whether working directly with growth marketing leads, founders, or agency creative directors, my focus is to provide absolute strategic clarity. No generic fluff, no creative compromise, just measurable pipeline impact.

projects.brief: From a single physical office in Surrey, BC to a digital trust framework generating insurance and investment leads across Canada.
projects.about_brand: Wiseconomy is a Canadian financial and insurance advisory brand offering life insurance, savings investments, and its flagship Super Visa Insurance. Previously, the brand operated from a single brick-and-mortar office in Surrey, BC with no digital web footprint or appointment booking software, making it impossible to capture interest outside their immediate local municipal community.
projects.objective: Bridge the critical trust gap between the advisory brand and Canadian consumers (especially newcomers encountering credit, RRSPs, TFSAs, and life insurance policies for the first time). In this Your Money or Your Life (YMYL) category, establishing deep regulatory credibility and personal authority outweighs clever marketing slogans.
projects.strategy: Deployed an integrated content pipeline across web and social channels centered on a founder-led video series. The founder shared his own experience navigating the Canadian financial system as a newcomer, unpacking insurance nuances and savings frameworks to educate visitors and humanize the advisory process.
projects.founder_quote: his own experience navigating the Canadian financial system as a newcomer
projects.outcome: Transformed a local Surrey-only business into a trusted national brand. By converting web visitors into advisory calls, the brand now captures qualified insurance and investment leads from every Canadian province, alongside international travel-insurance leads from families abroad organizing coverage for visiting relatives.

projects.brief: End-to-end content strategy ownership for an online pet pharmacy. Structured content pillars, aligned seasonal search demand, and resolved sensitive compliance disclaimers.
projects.snapshot: HardyPaw is an online pet pharmacy selling prescription and OTC medications, supplements, and pet health products. The category makes this harder than typical D2C: content has to convert and hold up to pharmacy-level scrutiny (accuracy, compliance, misuse prevention).
projects.role_framing: Owned content strategy end-to-end — not brought in for isolated copy requests, but responsible for how content mapped to the funnel, supported SEO, maintained regulatory credibility, and drove retention.

scope_areas.title: Content Strategy & Planning
bullets: Defined core content pillars: pet health education, product guides, condition-specific content (joint care, dental, allergies), seasonal pet care
Built an editorial calendar aligned to product launches, seasonal pet health cycles, and search demand
Mapped content across the full customer journey: awareness (symptom/condition searches) → consideration (product comparisons) → purchase (product pages) → retention (dosing guides, reorder prompts)

scope_areas.title: SEO-Driven Content
bullets: Category and collection page copy (e.g., 'Joint Care for Dogs')
Condition and ingredient hub pages (arthritis, allergies, dental care) built to funnel traffic into relevant products
Blog and guide content targeting high-intent informational searches (dosage questions, symptom guides, senior pet care)
Keyword research and content gap analysis against competitor pet pharmacies

scope_areas.title: Product & Category Copy
bullets: Product descriptions balancing persuasive copy with pharmacy-grade accuracy — dosing, usage, warnings
FAQ content, with particular care around misuse disclaimers on medications with known off-label misuse risk (a real sensitivity area for this category, evident in customer reviews)
Comparison content helping customers choose between similar supplements/medications for their pet's specific condition

scope_areas.title: Trust & Compliance Content
bullets: Credibility content: NABP accreditation messaging, sourcing and cold-chain/temperature-handling transparency, prescription process explainers
Clear, non-misleading language throughout — especially for medications carrying off-label misuse risk, where vague or overly casual copy becomes a liability

scope_areas.title: Email & Retention Content
bullets: Reorder reminders and refill nudges for chronic conditions (joint care, allergies)
Educational nurture sequences for new pet owners entering the funnel

scope_areas.title: Brand Voice & Messaging
bullets: Built the brand's tone framework — balancing 'warm, pet-loving' against 'credible healthcare provider,' a harder line to hold than either extreme alone
Delivered a style guide and messaging framework to keep product, blog, and email content consistent

scope_areas.title: Performance Content
bullets: Worked alongside SEO/analytics to iterate content based on what was actually converting

before_after.before: HardyPaw Joint Max Joint Supplement for Dogs containing Glucosamine, Chondroitin, and MSM. Dose: 1 chew daily for dogs under 40 lbs.
before_after.after: Does your dog hesitate before the stairs? Don't wait for a limp. Our cold-pressed Glucosamine chews protect active cartilage before stiffness starts, delivering targeted joint lubrication in a daily treat dogs actually love.

before_after.before: Can I give Fish Mox to my dog if they have a cut? Yes, it's just amoxicillin, but make sure to check with your vet for the right dose.
before_after.after: Is Fish Mox safe for dogs? No. While Fish Mox contains amoxicillin, veterinary fish antibiotics are not manufactured under FDA regulations for mammals and contain no safety labeling for dogs. Giving fish medication to dogs can lead to critical dosing errors or drug resistance. Always request a canine-approved prescription from your vet.
